company.name: Trusted Shops
company.description:
The European trust brand.

It‘s all about trust
We dream of a digital world we can trust. That’s why Trusted Shops has been working hard since its founding in 1999: to ensure that we can all make the best possible decisions in an increasingly digital world. We started with our Trustmark including Buyer Protection for more orientation and real security when shopping online. Today, our feedback system brings real transparency to all digital sectors, far beyond just e-commerce, and we offer online shops legal services, ranging from protections against Abmahnungen (German legal warnings) to data privacy solutions.

One team of experts, all liberties of work
The most important value in our company is trust. Of course, this also means that we trust each other and treat each other kindly. We, as a team of over 700 colleagues, strive for a common result: to make our customers, partners, and colleagues happy. To achieve this, we work together with passion and dedication – and a lot of joy. We aim to be successful together, pursue our goals with a results-oriented approach, and foster a company culture where we all feel comfortable and can grow. With our hybrid work culture we combine the best of both worlds: The individual flexibility of remote work and valuable face-to-face time with your colleagues on site.

Trusted Shops connects people, brands, and organizations. Get connected with us and use your skills to make the world a better place.
